titulo.alumno: Telling facts from opinions · Integrated reading A2+

intro: Part 3: telling facts from opinions. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: Read the question before rereading. For a date or quantity, find the exact detail; for a conclusion, combine two clues from the text and avoid adding information that does not appear.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

frases.estudio: Rådet oplyser, at parken får nye bænke i juni.
frases.alumno: The council informs that the park will have new benches in June.

frases.estudio: En beboer synes, at arbejdet burde begynde tidligere.
frases.alumno: A resident thinks that the work should start earlier.
